result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now collects only active contributors. I compiled the `codeanalyzer` module, which succeeded. I didn't run any tests or add one for this case.

The change is one added condition in `getAllTeams()` in `LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, at the remainder check around line 747. A contributor matched by no team is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped.

I didn't need extra handling for blank dates. `Contributor.isActive()` goes through `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, which already returns true for a blank date. Configured teams are untouched and keep all their members.
